## fragmented-systems.png

Use case: ads-marketing. Premium cinematic conceptual illustration for a Nigerian school technology presentation about the human cost of fragmented software. A Nigerian female school administrator at a desk, serious and concerned but dignified, one hand at her temple, facing three separate laptop and monitor screens with incompatible abstract record layouts. Loose attendance sheets and folders on desk, a small clock, classroom softly visible beyond glass with out-of-focus students waiting. Visual metaphor: thin glowing red connection traces stop at gaps between devices; a subtle red warning triangle on one screen, padlock symbol on another. No legible text. Tasteful realistic 3D editorial illustration, tactile materials and lifelike faces, not cartoon, navy and muted blue with controlled coral red warning accents. Portrait-leaning 4:5 crop, subject centered with breathing space, no text, no watermark, no logos. Emotion: the school team deserves a system that works.
